title: Last Wave (3/3): The Cove - The Finale

characters.Kai: src/anim/cast.py KAI - lucky red Hawaiian shirt, shorts, flip-flops; works at the boardwalk surf shop
characters.Tess: 15, customer, dark ponytail, yellow hoodie, brave but scared, has never surfed
characters.The infected: grey-green skin, torn clothes, white eyes, slow then fast; they will not go into water

scenes.narration: ~Kick free? An infected lifeguard has Kai's ankle. In the dark. Half a mile from shore.
scenes.visual: grey hand on Kai's ankle in black water, KICK FREE?

scenes.narration: It pulled. Kai's board tipped. Tess screamed his name.
Kai kicked. Once. Twice. His flip-flop came off in the thing's hand.
And it held on to the flip-flop instead of him.
scenes.visual: the infected sinking, holding a blue flip-flop

scenes.narration: It sank. Slowly. Still holding it.
scenes.visual: the shape fading into the dark water

scenes.narration: Kai lay on his board, shaking. Could be worse, he said. I had two of those.
scenes.visual: Kai on the board, exhausted, half smiling

scenes.narration: Tess didn't laugh. She was pointing at the shore.
The infected were still walking along the beach. Following them. Waiting for them to come in.
scenes.visual: the line of infected on the sand in the moonlight

scenes.narration: So Kai looked for a place they couldn't reach.
A rocky point. And behind it, a tiny cove. Cliffs on every side. No way down from the road.
scenes.visual: the cove: a little beach walled in by cliffs

scenes.narration: The infected reached the rocks... and couldn't climb them.
scenes.visual: the infected stuck at the rocks

scenes.narration: Kai caught the last wave of the night. Tess too. Lying flat. Screaming the whole way in.
scenes.visual: both riding a wave into the cove

scenes.narration: They hit the sand and didn't move until the sun came up.
scenes.visual: both lying on the sand, dawn

scenes.narration: At seven, a coast guard boat came around the point. Then a helicopter.
scenes.visual: rescue boat and helicopter at dawn

scenes.narration: Shorts torn. One flip-flop. Sunburn on his nose. Sand everywhere.
But somehow... the shirt survived. Not a mark on it.
scenes.visual: insert: the pristine red Hawaiian shirt

scenes.narration: Tess hugged him. You owe me a surf lesson, she said. Kai laughed. Could be worse.
scenes.visual: Tess hugging Kai on the beach

scenes.narration: Paddle out? Would you have run for the water? Tell me in the comments, and follow. Tomorrow, Kai's next worst day.
scenes.visual: end card: PADDLE OUT? / NEW STORY TOMORROW
